content.short: zeroShadow provides blockchain intelligence and incident response after hacks and thefts.
content.description: zeroShadow works the aftermath of on-chain incidents, tracing stolen funds and coordinating with exchanges and law enforcement to freeze them. Monad's documentation lists it under analytics. Incident response is a distinct discipline from auditing: the audit firms try to prevent the exploit, while firms like this one are called in once the money is already moving.
